title: MAGI Income Limits and FPL Tables (2026 Coverage Year)
medicaid_expansion_limit: 138% FPL = $22,025/year ($1,836/month) for single adult (includes 5% disregard: effectively 138% = 133% + 5%)
covered_ca_subsidy_range: 100%-400% FPL = $15,960 to $63,840/year for single adult (2026). Subsidy cliff returned Jan 1, 2026 after ARP/IRA enhanced credits expired Dec 31, 2025.
note: Medi-Cal uses CURRENT monthly MAGI (with projection/annualization options). Past year tax return not determinative if income changed. If your monthly MAGI is low at application, you get Medi-Cal even if you earned more earlier in the year; inverse also true.
